subject.title: [Feature]: Async voice notes in the mobile chat composer (record and send as audio attachment)

question: Should OpenClaw add async voice-note recording to the first-party iOS and Android chat composers now, scoped to client-side recording plus existing `chat.send` audio attachments?
rationale: The feature is roadmap-aligned and source-supported, but the protected label and cross-platform mic/UX choices are product direction that automation should not decide.

options.title: Approve scoped mobile v1
options.body: Build iOS and Android recorder controls that send bounded AAC/M4A attachments through the existing gateway/media-understanding path, with manual device proof per platform.

options.title: Prototype one platform first
options.body: Start with either iOS or Android to validate recorder UX and mic coordination before committing to both apps.

options.title: Defer mobile voice notes
options.body: Keep users on Talk mode or third-party channels until mobile voice composer scope is prioritized explicitly.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped mobile v1
recommendation.body: Build iOS and Android recorder controls that send bounded AAC/M4A attachments through the existing gateway/media-understanding path, with manual device proof per platform.

likelyOwner.reason: Opened the feature request and appears in recent adjacent voice/mobile routing history, making him the best available product-direction owner from the evidence.
